plan: Reduce QQQI to 20% to ease concentration.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to cut risk.
Exit underperforming tech/semis (METU, MUU, SMH).
Increase SPY to 25% for broad market stability.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation.
Expect lower volatility and modest growth.
conservative.read: This mode aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly growth. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged positions and focusing on stable assets, but this also limits upside potential and increases cash holdings.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to manage concentration.
Reduce leveraged ETFs (SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 1%).
Trim underperforming tech/semis (METU to 3%, MUU to 2%).
Add QQQ to 15% for broader tech exposure.
Initiate a new position in VRT at 4%.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly growth while prioritizing risk management. It trims leverage and concentration, blending broad market exposure with select quality names and a small allocation to promising new setups. Drawdowns are expected to be moderate.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to manage concentration.
Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL to 6%, SPAL to 6%).
Increase exposure to AI/Software and Semiconductors (METU to 6%, MUU to 6%).
Add QQQ to 15% for broad tech exposure.
Initiate a new position in VRT at 6%.
This plan aggressively pursues growth through leverage and concentration.
aggressive.read: This aggressive mode targets higher growth, around 4% monthly, by embracing leverage and concentration in high-conviction names. It accepts significantly higher potential drawdowns and the risks associated with leveraged ETFs, including daily decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Increase QQQI to 30% for enhanced income potential.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to eliminate risk.
Exit high-beta growth stocks (CRWD, SNOW) and weak tech (METU, MUU).
Add SPY to 20% for broad market stability.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income over growth.
Expect low volatility and reliable distributions, but NAV can still fall.
income.read: This income-focused mode targets around 1% monthly growth through distributions. It shifts heavily into income-generating assets like QQQI and broad index ETFs, while cutting all leveraged and high-beta growth positions. The focus is on capital preservation and consistent cash flow, not aggressive appreciation.
